create_haiku_module: create a Haiku Module subclass with a __call__ method to define a custom neural network layer
use_name_scope: use hk.name_scope to add a prefix to all modules, parameters, and state created within a context block
intercept_module_methods: register a method interceptor with hk.intercept_methods to modify args or kwargs before a module method is called
force_module_name: use hk.force_name to force a module to use an absolute name ignoring all context and parent naming
use_name_like_decorator: apply the hk.name_like decorator to a method so submodules are named as if created in another method
